statement: For fixed positive masses and fixed positive common gain, the existing attachment Phi(c)=B_m*gain*R(c), with R the actual native pair of route lengths, represents every real two-body momentum state of the independently specified single-port elastic domain.
source: research/nima/agda/NativeFeedbackRouteReadout.agda: reading has codomain Nat x Nat
target: The full real two-momentum plane with the existing mixed elastic map and positive kinetic form; not only its prepared (1,2) orbit.
fixed_data: The existing B_m, gain>0, port, source observer and target momentum interpretation. No signed counts, changed preparation schema, offsets, rephasing quotient or state-dependent calibration.
test: Consider p*=B_m*gain*(1,-1). It is a real admissible counter-moving momentum pair, with finite positive kinetic energy. Invertibility of B_m and gain forces any preimage to have route lengths (1,-1), impossible in Nat x Nat.
acceptance: Every real target pair has an admitted source comparison under this same attachment.
falsifier: An admissible target pair has no source preimage.
boundary: Refutes full-domain coverage by this fixed observer attachment only. Preserves its scoped action/intertwining ++ and does not refute a different source presentation or the governing tower-cut conjecture.
